stem.text: A spring of original length $100\,\text{mm}$ is compressed by a force. The graph shows the variation of the compressing force $F$ with the length $L$ of the spring.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis F/N from 0 to 12 and horizontal axis L/mm from 40 to 100, on a grid, with one straight line plotted.

stem.text: What is the energy stored in the spring when the length is $70\,\text{mm}$?
